content.short: Bitget Wallet is a premier multi-chain Web3 wallet providing comprehensive ecosystem services including swapping, NFT trading, and a dApp browser.
content.description: Bitget Wallet (formerly BitKeep) is a world-leading non-custodial multi-chain wallet that serves millions of users across 100+ blockchains. It offers a powerful suite of integrated tools such as Bitget Swap for intelligent DEX aggregation and an advanced NFT marketplace. Deeply integrated with the Mantle Network, Bitget Wallet provides seamless asset management, high-performance RPC access, and a dedicated portal for exploring the Mantle ecosystem's top decentralized applications.
content.meta: Bitget Wallet is a premier multi-chain Web3 wallet with deep integration for the Mantle Network. Discover Bitget Wallet on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
